liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): The transition from Wharf Rat to Sugar Magnolia was preferred by the reviewer; Wharf Rat took on a very psychedelic character during the performance [16][19]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Little Red Rooster was wild and crazy, though only in the first set [23]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Cassidy transitioning to Deal provided a strong conclusion to the first set [16]
- **Just A Little Light** (1 review): Just a Little Light is described as a very solid, under-appreciated song [25]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Estimated Prophet features energetic vocals and a dreamy jam, highlighted by Jerry's reluctance to end it [25]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes of the World became particularly nice toward the middle of the jam [19]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): The Wheel performance is considered one of the finest from their later era [22]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Bobby performed some pretty good rock star chords on Sugar Magnolia [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **Queen Jane Approximately**: cut on the recording [1]
- **//The Last Time**: cut on the recording [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-02-25.168839.nakcm300.cp1.ont.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 186 min [1]
- **gd1990-02-25.Nak300CP4.Fitzy.Keo.125809.Flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 173 min [2]
- **gd1990-02-25.mtx.tobin.82923.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: Level fluctuations occur in the beginning of set 1, and slight static is present in Space [7]
- **gd1990-02-25.sbd.hinko.29345.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 167 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [9]. Said about its sound: The soundboard recording is described as having good sound quality; Minor sound problems exist on the master tape, and the mix is not ideal [16][18]
- **gd1990-02-25.150674.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 175 min [10]
- **gd1990-02-25.fob.akgC568.b-and-d.andrewf.93476.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 164 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [12]. Said about its sound: The audience recording quality is poor at the beginning and end of the encore [20]

## Around the show

- The uploader drove from Morro Bay to Oakland and back in one night on three cylinders [1]
- The energy suggests the Spring of 1990 tour will be even better than 1989 [22]
- The reviewer feels these shows do not stick out as much as the rest of Spring Tour 90 [24]
- The show is considered well-played but not a barn burner, earning five stars for professional elements [26]
- The recording is rated A+, while the show itself is rated B [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-02-25.168839.nakcm300.cp1.ont.flac1644**: taped by OldNeumanntapr; transferred by OldNeumanntapr; source: OTS; Nakamichi CM-300's w/CP-1 Cardioid Capsules >Sony WM-D6C [XLIIS] [1]
- **gd1990-02-25.Nak300CP4.Fitzy.Keo.125809.Flac2496**: taped by fitzy; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By M.L./Keo, Transfer By Keo; Master Tapes Shared By Fitzy (His Deck/Tapes); Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes: Maxell… [2]. Also: Fitzy supplied master tapes, and the uploader and friend taped using Fitzy's and their own gear [2]
- **gd1990-02-25.mtx.tobin.82923.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (65%-SBD/35%-AUD) [7]. Also: Source lineage is SBD to DAT to C to DAT to CD to EAC to FLAC [7]
- **gd1990-02-25.sbd.hinko.29345.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko; source: flac16 SBD > DAT > C > DAT > CD > EAC > FLAC [9]
- **gd1990-02-25.150674.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Mixed and Recorded by Dan Healy and Don Pearson; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  September 27, 2020; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [10]
- **gd1990-02-25.fob.akgC568.b-and-d.andrewf.93476.sbeok.flac16**: taped by B and D; transferred by Andrew F.; source: FOB AUD: AKG C-568's > patched thru Panasonic SV-255 > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA (1st Set) & TDK MA-XG (2nd Set), with no Dolby. Mics on stand, thirty feet from the… [12]
